title: The lattice of varieties of semigroups with completely regular square. II
summary: We solve (modulo groups) the word problem for free semigroup satisfying $xy = (xy)^n$. This enables us to show that the variety ${\cal {SCR}}_n$ given by this identity is not equal to the join of the varieties ${\cal{CR}}_n$ and ${\cal{SI}}$ defined by the identities $x = x^n$ and $xy = (xy)^2$ respectively. Therefore the result of (M.V.Volkov, T.A.Ershova, The lattice of varieties of semigroup with completely regular square, Monash Conference on Semigroup Theory in Honour of G. B.
